description: Agreement with TAXSIM by release. Each row scores one policyengine-taxsim / policyengine-us pair, installed as PyPI stood at its release, against the TAXSIM side of the published full-data release named by `reference`, on the same households and tolerances as the dashboard. Counts only; a rate is a count over `records`. Written by scripts/alignment_history.py.
